accuracyFlags: Section 05 says 'Diesel vehicles additionally require road user charges': RUC also applies to electric vehicles (since 1 April 2024), plug-in hybrids and any vehicle over 3.5 t, so the diesel-only statement is incomplete.
Intro says light campervans 'generally need a current WoF', FAQ says 'every vehicle on the road needs a current one': inconsistent; heavier motorhomes use a Certificate of Fitness.
No cost, intervals (6 vs 12 months by age) or official figures despite the top queries being 'warrant of fitness and registration cost': add NZTA figures dated 2026.
Mentions 'registration labels on the windscreen' for rental checks: only the licence (rego) label and WoF label are displayed; avoid implying a separate registration label.
